title: The Toxic Innocence of Empire
author: Phil Rockstroh
content:
There is an exact and troubling historical correlation between the Trump
administration’s imperialist aggression against Venezuela and Israel’s
perpetual crimes against humanity. Both can be traced to a Western settler-
colonialist worldview possessed by a sense of insatiable entitlement, and the
psychological carnage concomitant to a citizenry given to the brutality
inherent to the pursuit of colonialist and/or imperialist agendas.

Whether the collective mode of mind is termed Manifest Destiny or Zionist
doctrine, both are manifested in the ethnic cleansing of indigenous people
that can be traced back to a European belief system that insists upon its
innate (White supremacy-rancid) superiority.

![undefined](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/01/undefined.jpeg)

American Progress (1872) by John Gast

Both the denizens of Manifest Destiny and Zionist true believers retail the
Big Lie: that the people resisting their land-thieving aggression are mindless
savages who, without provocation, and simply maddened by bloodlust, present an
existential threat to their (forever innocent and blameless) existence.

For example, unhinged, rage-frothing Zionist apologists’ accusations that
critiques of Israel -- are not only anti-semitic declarations -- but are
“Blood Libel.”

How could it be true, that, as a Jewish person, that because I experience a
sense of mortification in regard to the IDF perpetration of large scale
collective punishment in Gaza is analogous to the Middle Ages’ dark fantasy
that we Jews sprinkle gentile blood on our sabbath bread? Moreover, how could
it also be true that condemnation of the Zionist state’s acts of ethnic
cleansing in the West Bank and its perpetration of genocide in Gaza is
defamation directed at all Jews? Of course, the accusations are merely
attempts to silence critiques of Israeli policies.

**Speaking of a paucity of critique:**

At present, Democrats have a propitious opening to separate themselves from
Trump’s militaristic, imperialist caprice. Instead, we are subject to their
enabling palaver such as “the president should have informed Democrat
leadership in advance of his shakedown scheme to steal Venezuela’s oil
reserves.” Yet Democrats, de facto, co-sign the lie that he was in some manner
entitled to imposed regime change on a sovereign nation because its leader
“was a narco-trafficking, election stealing dictator.”

Has a Democrat retorted that Trump attempted, by dictatorial whim, to remain
in office in the wake of an election he lost in 2020, even by attempting to
foment an insurrection to that deranged end?

Have any Democrats asserted, Trump, a man who regards the Gaza genocide as an
opportunity for real estate transactions, should be placed in shackles, then
frogmarched to The Hague to face a war crimes tribunal for his abuse of US
military power, both on a domestic and international basis. Have any liberals
averred: fascism is imperialism turned homeward?

Joe Biden’s noxious policies towards Israel and Venezuela set the stage for
Trump’s – the Big Mac-bloated Caligula – imperialist designs. War profiteers-
owned Democrats have all but placed a laurel wreath crown (_corona
triumphalis_) on the wannabe emperor’s head…and yes, Trump, The High Chair
Emperor, in his perpetual swoon of infantile omnipotence, would gloat that his
name can be discerned from the Latin root of the term.

The gods elevate – then make mad – who they aim to destroy.

**On the subject of madness of the grandiose, imperialistic kind:**

The Trump Whitehouse’s resident Heinrich Himmler, Stephen Miller made the
declaration:

“We live in a world, in the real world, Jake, that is governed by strength,
that is governed by force, that is governed by power. These are the iron laws
of the world since the beginning of time.”

Someone should intervene on Heir Miller by imposing a history book in front of
his (cartoon) hyper-authoritarian face. The Thousand Year Reich lasted all of
twelve years.

Benito Mussolini and his Blackshirt thugs held out a bit longer, about 20
years, before Il Duce’s and his mistress’ lifeless bodies were hung, upside
down, on public display, from a lamppost in Milan.

**The collective madness of imperial overreach:**

In Vietnam, US war profiteers, and the political class they owned, lied the
nation into the Big Muddy; then in Iraq, a sand pit. An attempted theft of
Venezuelan oil fields could be a trudge into a jungle green hellscape.

Trump is a practitioner of the short con. The realities of war are beyond his
cupidity-rancid take on life. Trump was born into the New York City culture of
grift -- that is the terrain Trump knows …that is his swamp — not the morass
of a land war in a tropical clime wherein the locals move in stealth beneath
the green on green gradations of the jungle canopy, a bewildering, alien
terrain that bogs down military hardware, boggles the minds of yankee troops,
and its death-delivering verities are far beyond the grasp of a blowhard
manqué like Trump and his administration of lickspittle tools and preening
fools.

It is a US imperialist Big Lie (of the Saddam Hussein possesses Weapons Of
Mass Destruction kind) that the “dictator” Nicolás Maduro rigged his election.

Insofar as election-rigging proclivities: The hyper-capitalist US is a
dictatorship of money. The moneyed class owns and controls the US political
class, and thus determines every aspect of your day. You believe you have
choices, huh? Money, the amount you possess or are lacking in, determines the
trajectory of your day, from when you rise, to what you take in as nutrition,
to where your day will take you, to at what hour you arrive home, and when you
surrender to sleep, and start it all again on a new day.

Can you envisage a more odious con job i.e., being sold the defining lie of
The United States Of Perpetual Grift — as is the case with Nicolás Maduro and
his wife — your life has been abducted by capitalist interests.

**It should not be a mystery as to the reason mental illness is pandemic in
the US and Israel.**

As has been the case in the US there has been a flurry of news about a steep
rise in mental health issues among the Israeli public. The unhinged comments
to which I’m, relentlessly, subject to on my comment threads on social media
appear to confirm the fact. For example, the following straw man fallacy
formation, constructed into the troll’s personal insane asylum, was raged in
my pixel direction on my Substack platform’s comment thread,

_“Phil, you kapo, why do you think the world would be a better place if Israel
was destroyed by hordes of caliphates?”_

Hordes of caliphates aside, the world would be, a bit, improved if Israel
became a true democracy, established a Palestinian Right Of Return, with
heartfelt amends proffered, and provided generous reparations to the
Palestinian people for their 80 years of subjugation by the Zionist state.
Moreover, I believe the action would bestow a healing effect upon the troubled
psyches of the Israeli citizenry.

This much is true, if the ending of Israel’s ethno-supremacist status ceased
to be, its leaders tried for war crimes, and the Zionist state ended its
policy of ethnic cleansing and its compulsion for genocidal campaigns…that
would be a mitzvah for all. As it would if the US ceased its imperial campaign
in Venezuela.

**More missives from the madhouse: Of Moses and Muck-Headed Mythos:**

Zionist true believer to me, _“Phil, you self-hating Jew, read the Torah, God
gave us Israel, The Promised Land; Zionism is G-d’s will. Get with your blood.
Get with your true people.”_

He, our perpetual angry Sky Father, did just that…according to the lore and
mythology of Bronze Age barbarians.

Regarding my blood, my DNA reports, I have ancestors from Greece. Thus, I am
entitled to enter Greece, and home invasion style, claim as property whatever
my eye surveys, and it is all righteous and legal for me to do so…all in
Zeus’s name.

Let us pray: Zeus’s will be done on earth as it is on Olympus.

**ICE criminal insanity becomes increasingly murderous:**

A doctor offering to provide medical aid to Renee Nicole Good after she was
shot in the head by ICE in Minneapolis,

“I’m a physician.”

ICE thug: “I don’t care.”

ICE brownshirts gun down an unarmed woman in Minnesota, USA. Israel has killed
more journalists and outside observers in Gaza than in any military conflict
in history.

The fascist Trump administration evinces utter contempt for international law.
Authoritarian regimes claim the law is what they, by arrogant whim, say it is.

Said actions display sociopathic personality traits.

There is ever increasing evidence that MAGA USA and the Zionist state are
asylums for the criminally insane masquerading as nations.
